_comment: Canonical PRIMITIVE STATE vocabulary: the element-level state animations that the entrance planner EMITS and that BOTH renderers (html_adapter player, raster_renderer) must IMPLEMENT. Before this contract the vocabulary (draw/chart_fill/bars_grow/color_wash/pulse, plus the beat-level settle marker) was emitted by motion_canonical.entrance::interactions and consumed by two renderers with NO contract declaring it -- a shared, unchecked protocol. This contract is the single source of truth; tests/phase0/test_primitive_states.py enforces producer/consumer agreement and forbids undeclared actions.

single_source_of_truth_boundary.note: This contract ONLY covers the per-element STATE-ANIMATION vocabulary layered on top of drawing and motion; it does not redefine shapes or enter/exit motion.

event_shape.action: string (a key of state_actions or resolve_actions)

draw.semantics: stroke a connector progressively, arrowhead at completion

chart_fill.semantics: sweep the donut arc by value*progress

bars_grow.semantics: grow the bars from the baseline

color_wash.semantics: blend text color from ink toward its role color

pulse.semantics: scale pulse over the host element across the beat

settle.semantics: beat-level pacing marker at PHASES.resolve; carried on the beat, not read per element

consumer_obligations: every key of state_actions must be handled by every consumer renderer
producers must emit only declared actions
resolve_actions are beat-level and need not be read per element
